title: Understanding Your Dashboard
help: Run your event on the night
Change your password or sign out

steps.say: This is your event dashboard. It opens right after you sign in.
My events lists every event on your account.
Each event has four buttons. Plan is where you get ready.
Your date, countdown and to-do list live here, with your budget and vendors.
Tap My event dashboard to go back.
Stay and Go keeps travel for your guests: where they stay, shared costs, and who has paid.
Help desk answers quick questions. Just type a few words.
Settings has your name, email, password, and sign out.
On the day, tap Run it. You're signed in, so you don't need a PIN.
That opens your event console. Next up: running the night.
